<script>
  // Copyright year
  $(function() {
    date = new Date().getFullYear()
    $('.js-copyright-year').text(date);

    if (Cookies.get('cookie-notice') == 'remove-notice') {
      $('.cookie-notice').remove();
    } else {
      // hide notice until we've checked for the cookie
      $('.cookie-notice').removeClass('d-none').addClass('d-flex');
    }
  });

  // Scroll stopping for modal
  var stopScroll = false;

  $('[data-toggle=expandModal]').click(function(){
    var height = $(window).height();
    var width = $(window).width();

    if(height > width) {
      var size = height;
    } else {
      size = width
    }

    $(this).closest('.expand-modal').toggleClass('open')
      .find('.expand-modal-background')
      .css('height', size)
      .css('width', size);

    $('body').toggleClass('fix-scrollbars-for-modal-hack')

    if (!stopScroll) {
      stopScroll = true;
      stopWindowScrollPosition = $(window).scrollTop();
    } else {
      stopScroll = false;
    }
  });

  $(document).keyup(function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      $(document).find('.expand-modal').removeClass('open')
      stopScroll = false;
      $('body').toggleClass('fix-scrollbars-for-modal-hack')
    }
  });

  $(window).scroll(function(){
    if(stopScroll) {
      $(window).scrollTop(stopWindowScrollPosition);
    }
  });

  $('[data-toggle=close-cookie-notice]').click(function(){
    $(this).closest('.cookie-notice').remove();
    Cookies.set('cookie-notice', 'remove-notice', { expires: 15 });
  });

  // Menu drawer toggle
  var backdrop = '<div class="toggle-backdrop"></div>'

  $('[data-toggle=menu]').click( function() {
    $('#menu').toggleClass('open')
    $('#menu').attr('aria-hidden', false)

    if ($('body').find('.toggle-backdrop').length > 0) {
      return removeBackdrop()
    } else {
      $('body').append(backdrop)
    }
  });

  $('body').on('click', '.toggle-backdrop', function() {
    $('body').find('.open').removeClass('open')
    removeBackdrop()
  });

  function removeBackdrop() {
    $('#menu').attr('aria-hidden', true)
    $('body').find('.toggle-backdrop').remove()
  }

  // CTA click tracking
  $('[data-tracking-code]').click(function(){
    var trackingPlatform = $(this).data("tracking-platform");
    var trackingCode = $(this).data("tracking-code");

    trackInstall(trackingPlatform, trackingCode)
  });

  function trackInstall(platform, label) {
    try {
      ga('send', 'event', 'install', platform, label)
    } catch (e) {}
  }
</script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/@glidejs/glide"></script>
<script>
      glideOne = new Glide('.glide-1', {
        startAt: 0,
        focusAt: 0,
        peek: 56,
      });

      glideTwo = new Glide('.glide-2', {
        startAt: 0,
        focusAt: 0,
        peek: 56,
      })

      glideOne.mount();
      glideTwo.mount();

    </script>
</body></html>
